capabilities: Ask questions across selected vault folders and get cited answers
Open citations to the note, heading, PDF page, or web source behind a claim
Index Markdown, TXT, PDF, EPUB, FB2, and DOCX files with an embedding model
Use local models via Ollama or LM Studio or connect a cloud API
Save answers as a new note or append them to the active note
extras: Local model endpoints are unavailable on mobile (cloud required there); scanned PDFs without a text layer are not readable; a tool-enabled model can create, update, or delete notes unless a read-only profile is used. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7+.
problem: Vault search returns lists of notes rather than written answers, and it gives no way to jump from an answer's claims back to the exact source.

summary: AI chat plugin that answers questions over vault notes and optional web sources, with citations linking to notes, headings, PDF pages, or URLs.
